description: This file defines the SegmentationPolicy model class used for configuring Ethernet frame segmentation parameters in a satellite link project. It includes fields for maximum segment size, alignment, CRC inclusion, ARQ enabling, and FEC scheme, along with a method to normalize segment sizes.

classes.name: SegmentationPolicy
classes.description: A Pydantic model defining configuration parameters for Ethernet frame segmentation, including size limits, alignment, CRC, ARQ, and FEC scheme.

methods.name: int normalized_size(self, requested: int | None = None)
methods.description: Calculates and returns a normalized segment size aligned to the 'align_to' boundary, ensuring the size stays within defined limits.
